_note: Durable TNR visual reference pack. Provenance, exact-byte hashes and selection metadata for the approved live scene art. Binaries live under art/style_refs/ so the skill ZIP stays inside its 2 MiB guard; this index is packaged with the skill. JUTSU_ICON style exemplars (director-approved BBE/BEE jutsu.image finals) live under art/style_refs/jutsu_icons/ with delivery provenance in `deliveries` instead of a live capture.
authority_note: References calibrate; the spec governs. 25x_DATA_art_spec.json remains the sole authority for house-style clauses, target numbers, aspect, delivered width, format, chroma, byte ceilings and the measured signature. Nothing here restates them. The tags, registers and priorities below are selection metadata, not art doctrine.

source_capture.note: Read-only gameAsset.get capture, persist:"full". The capture owns the live image URL and record state used for this pack; catalogs do not.

registers.NINJA: Forsworn-era ninja scene characters. Selection metadata for choosing references.
registers.CIVILIAN: Non-combatant scene characters in the established earth-tone civilian register.

excluded.name: Nameless Ninja
excluded.reason: Deprecated/rejected for new-quality work. Never a positive reference; verify rejects it if it is ever added.

selection_notes.SCENE_CHARACTER: Default limit 4. NINJA selection leads with Commander Okabe as the rendering/detail anchor, then the current full-body Forsworn references for framing, silhouette and costume register. CIVILIAN selection leads with Keeper / Grain Merchant / Deputy.
selection_notes.SCENE_BACKGROUND: Default limit 3. Background choice is expected to be tag-driven (--tag interior, --tag rural-road, --tag yard, ...) for the intended location. The untagged default is a range sample across interior / road / yard, not a quality ranking. Known limitation of v1: every background in the pack is a night or dusk scene, so the pack carries no daylight precedent.
selection_notes.JUTSU_ICON: Default limit 1: a jutsu generation takes at most two images, normally one legacy identity icon from the target bloodline's art pack plus one style exemplar from here. Every JUTSU_ICON reference is STYLE/MATERIAL ONLY - never a composition, palette or silhouette to copy. PRIMARY entries are the ones that still read at 32px; the ordering is a reversible selection default set at intake, not an art-direction ruling. Use --family BBE for a crystal/ice material lead, --family BEE for a dark-ground glow lead, or --tag to filter. Each entry's silhouette is reserved by its family; list them with `list --target JUTSU_ICON` when writing exclusions.

references.name: Commander Okabe
references.use_for: Face and near-detail rendering anchor, and the only unmasked bust-to-waist reference in the pack. Look here for how much facial and garment detail a TNR scene character carries.
references.do_not_use_for: NOT the framing/aspect target and NOT the alpha-edge quality target. It is square rather than the full-body scene-character framing, and the art spec records it as the weakest exemplar of the ratified set on soft-edge share. Take framing, silhouette and edge quality from the Forsworn references instead.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Winter Crow
references.use_for: Current full-body ninja framing and silhouette; the heaviest armoured build in the set. Closest live precedent for a new Forsworn-era ninja scene character.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Pale Fang
references.use_for: Second armoured full-body ninja silhouette, hooded, carrying a cool accent. Use alongside Winter Crow to see how much variation the register tolerates.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Old Ghost
references.use_for: Robed, unarmoured full-body ninja silhouette behind a full face mask. Use when the subject is not in combat plate.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Squad Survivor
references.use_for: Additional current full-body ninja reference in lighter, less formal dress, and the only one showing bare skin and visible injury. An incidental scene figure rather than a named operative, so it sits behind the named set in the default selection.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Keeper
references.use_for: Primary civilian register: a hooded earth-tone mantle over a long working robe at full-body framing. Start a new civilian scene character here.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Grain Merchant
references.use_for: Civilian trade register: a layered brown working robe carrying none of the ninja costume grammar.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Deputy
references.use_for: Civilian office register: an older figure in civil robes with a coloured cord rather than combat gear. Use when the subject carries office rather than combat capability.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Warehouse Clerk
references.use_for: Supporting civilian reference: indoor working dress, spectacles and a carried ledger - a worked example of a civilian holding a prop.

references.name: Forsworn Scene - Principal
references.use_for: Supporting civilian reference: a dark high-collared formal tunic, the most closed-up civilian silhouette in the set.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Pass Road Dusk
references.use_for: Mountain pass road at dusk behind a stone retaining wall. The clearest read on the low-value, low-saturation exterior treatment the live scene backgrounds use.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Warehouse Loading Floor
references.use_for: Interior timber warehouse with the loading doors open to the water. Use for any enclosed location and for how interior depth is staged without a figure present.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Drying Yard
references.use_for: Enclosed working yard at night: paved ground, perimeter wall, gate and a hoist. Nearest precedent for a walled compound or work-yard location.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Waystation Door
references.use_for: A built threshold on a hillside with a lit interior beyond. Use for doorway and entrance staging.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - East Road Ambush Site
references.use_for: Roadside location beside a high stone wall, composed for an encounter rather than a conversation; a single ground lantern carries the light.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Drying Shed
references.use_for: Exterior of a long timber outbuilding with one lit doorway. Use for modest rural structures seen from outside.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Rooftop Eastern Quarter
references.use_for: Elevated urban vantage across tiled roofs. Use for rooftop and overlook compositions.

references.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Canal Frontage
references.use_for: Urban waterside frontage with moored boats. The only water-carrying reference in the v1 pack.

references.name: Hemocure
references.silhouette: glowing sphere cradled by dark claws
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Best single-focal readability in either family: one luminous object, a strong rim light and a clean dark surround. It still reads as one shape at 32px. The default style anchor for value contrast and focal hierarchy.
references.do_not_use_for: Not a palette source for another bloodline, and not a composition to copy: centred orb-in-claws is BEE's reserved silhouette.

references.name: Sapphire Command
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: Best crystal/material rendering that survives 32px: translucent faceted edges, crisp highlights and a bold diagonal rhythm over a busy ground. Use it for how dimensional chakra material is rendered.
references.do_not_use_for: Not the high-key all-blue value plan, which flattens other BBE icons when small. Three parallel cuts are BBE's reserved silhouette.

references.name: Reaper's Embrace
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: A weapon icon done right: the object reads instantly while the glowing sweep, not the handle, carries the action. A good reference when a technique genuinely needs a weapon.
references.do_not_use_for: Do not import a scythe or crescent sweep into another family; both are reserved.

references.name: Arctic Frost
references.silhouette: sword sweeping a crescent ice arc
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: The one BBE icon with real dark negative space, which is why it reads at 32px. Shows the faceted ice idiom used with a value break behind the subject.
references.do_not_use_for: Its crescent arc sits close to Reaper's Embrace; neither shape is free for a new family.

references.name: Crimson Tithe
references.silhouette: chalice receiving a falling vertical stream
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Object plus cause/effect in one read: the vertical stream gives motion while the chalice anchors the base. A good model for depicting what a technique does without an actor.
references.do_not_use_for: Chalice/vessel and falling-stream shapes are reserved.

references.name: Blue Crimson
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: Speed and displacement trails rendered in faceted ice, with the strongest motion vocabulary in BBE.
references.do_not_use_for: At 32px the streaks soften into the bright field; do not copy its value plan.

references.name: Glacial Volley
references.silhouette: fan of ice lances converging to one side
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: How to render many projectiles as one directional mass rather than scattered pieces.
references.do_not_use_for: Moderate small-size read only; the converging lance fan is reserved.

references.name: Blade Resonance
references.silhouette: vertical sword with concentric resonance rings
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: A detailed weapon rendered in the ice idiom.
references.do_not_use_for: Concentric rings are the generic chakra-ring motif the studio workflow forbids as a default; do not take the ring layout.

references.name: Ice Shackles
references.silhouette: X of frozen chains closing on a central seal
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: Chain-link crystal material detail.
references.do_not_use_for: Centred symmetric layout becomes indistinct texture at 32px; never use as a composition reference.

references.name: Icebound Might
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: Large-block crystal massing for defensive or reinforcement techniques.
references.do_not_use_for: Symmetric frontal mass reads as texture at 32px; never use as a composition reference.

references.name: Quintessential Flake
references.family_material: Icy cobalt/white faceted crystal on a bright ice field.
references.use_for: Crystal edge and highlight treatment only.
references.do_not_use_for: A radial mandala-like composition, which the studio workflow forbids as a default; blurs at 32px.

references.name: Ring of Spilled Blood
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Glowing liquid edges and smoke falloff on black.
references.do_not_use_for: Spirals are an easy generic default and BEE's reserved shape; do not take the composition.

references.name: Crimson Impact
references.silhouette: upward burst from a ground impact point
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Directional energy release from one focal point.
references.do_not_use_for: Generic explosion bursts are discouraged; use for glow falloff only.

references.name: Sanguine Plague
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Smoke-formed figure with ember-lit edges.
references.do_not_use_for: v3 is NOT the version in the BEE closeout (which approved v2); pinned on the director's 2026-10-17 instruction. A skull/face is a reserved shape.

references.name: Unholy Enhancement
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Glowing vein/line material.
references.do_not_use_for: An all-over texture field with no dominant shape; turns to noise at 32px. Never a composition reference.

references.name: Thousand Strike
references.family_material: Crimson glow and smoke on a near-black ground.
references.use_for: Sharp glowing projectile edges.
references.do_not_use_for: Dense repeated needles read as noise at 32px. Never a composition reference.

_inspected: Every use_for note below was written after looking at the materialized image, not from its record name. Where a record name implies more than the image shows, the note describes the image.
